sources.title: BARTpho - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: We present BARTpho with two versions — BARTpho_word and BARTpho_syllable — the first public large-scale monolingual sequence-to-sequence models pre-trained for Vietnamese. Our BARTpho uses the "large" architecture and pre-training scheme of the sequence-to-sequence denoising model BART, thus especially suitable for generative NLP tasks.
